collection.title: Citroen C-Crosser 2007 to 2013 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Citroen C-Crosser 2007 - 2013 model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also have rear blades for this C-Crosser, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
